messages:
incident-bot: P1 alert — gen-queue error spike in eu-west-1. Error rate > 500/s, 5xxs and backpressure. Paging mike (oncall).

mike (oncall): Seen it, joining. Can someone confirm customer impact? Which endpoints affected?

sara (ops): Appears concentrated on streaming/generation routes for embeddings+chat. Some customers seeing timeouts ~30s then retries. No full GCP zone loss.

alex (eng): Quick look at gen-queue logs: lots of KV cache misses and worker OOMs. Recent cache eviction tweak landed ~10m ago. Suspect eviction thrash.

mike (oncall): Good catch. @alex, can you roll back eviction tweak or raise workers? Which is faster?

alex (eng): Rollback config will be fastest. Doing a canary revert to ring-2 now. Command: `kubectl set env deploy/gen-workers CACHE_EVICTION=default --namespace=prod-eu`

sara (ops): Rolling upscales as fallback: `k scale deploy gen-workers --replicas=12 -n prod-eu` if revert not stable.

jenna (docs): We need an initial status update for status.redwood.com. Draft below — please quick review.

jenna (docs): ```Initial update: We are investigating elevated error rates affecting generation endpoints in eu-west-1. Some customers may see increased latency and failed requests. Our on-call and engineering teams are working on a rollback of a recent cache configuration change to restore normal traffic. Next update in 15 minutes.```

mike (oncall): +1. Add ETA: investigating, mitigation in progress. Tag customer-impact as partial degradation.

sara (ops): Also add guidance for customers: retry with backoff; recommend switching to dedicated capacity if severe.

jenna (docs): Updated draft: ```Impact: Partial degradation of generation and streaming responses in eu-west-1. Mitigation: rolling back cache eviction change; temporary worker scale-up if needed. Recommendation: use exponential backoff; operations are ongoing.```

mike (oncall): Legal approval needed for any language implying SLA impact. @legal-bot please advise quick.

legal-bot: Suggest avoid explicit SLA numbers. Use "may be impacted" phrasing. Ok to publish initial update.

mike (oncall): Publishing initial status now. Will post follow-ups every 15m or on milestone (mitigation complete, rollback done, resolved).

incident-bot: status.redwood.com post published (initial) — link: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/incident-1768902410

alex (eng): Revert rolled to ring-2; monitoring logs. CPU/ooms trending down, error-rate dropping ~40% after 90s.

sara (ops): If stable for 10m, prepare resolved message. If error-rate drops but > baseline, plan for scale-up and longer remediation.

mike (oncall): Current plan: continue to monitor. Next update at 1768903310 (approx 15m). Jenna, please draft follow-up and resolved template: short cause summary + mitigation steps + customer-facing postmortem link to come.

jenna (docs): Follow-up draft ready: ```Update: We rolled back a recent cache eviction change which reduced error rates. Some customers may still experience intermittent errors. Engineering continues to monitor; we will follow up with a root cause analysis within 72 hours.```

alex (eng): Confirming stabilization. Error-rate now at ~1.3x baseline and trending down. No further config changes planned.

mike (oncall): Publishing follow-up. If stabilizes to baseline within 30m then publish resolved: ```Resolved: A configuration change to KV cache eviction triggered thrashing and increased memory churn, causing worker OOMs and higher error rates. We reverted the change and scaled workers as a precaution. Normal service restored; we will publish a detailed postmortem in 72 hours.```

incident-bot: Follow-up published. Monitor window started.

sara (ops): Marking affected customers for outreach list: customers on shared-hosting in eu-west-1 with >1000 requests/min. Assigning to support for targeted emails if impact persists.

jenna (docs): Preparing customer email template and postmortem outline.

mike (oncall): Great. Thanks team — keep updates concise. Close thread once resolved message published and a postmortem PR is opened. :thumbsup:
